photos.c: Wearing the English Rose, M40 Jim Estall (220) grafts away at the head of the Home Countries International Veterans' Cross Country Champs. at Ballymena on November 8th.  It's the fourth of  five laps and still no-one has been able to dominate the field.  However, the tattooed Rob Wise, close up behind Jim at this point, was soon to make a decisive move.  Gerry Brady (211) of Ireland was unable to respond while Mike Hagar and Jim gave chase.  On the final lap the Belgravian overtook Hagar to gain a clear 2nd in 31:55 but Wise at 31:37 was out of reach.
